en.title: New App Released!
en.message:
A brand-new app is now available to replace the old 3WiFi Locator.

It includes many new features: Wi-Fi maps, WPA key generators, a neighbor-based WPS PIN generator (just like on the 3WiFi website), PixieDust, the ability to locate Wi-Fi networks by MAC address, and much more.

You can download it from GitHub:
https://github.com/LowSkillDeveloper/WIFI-Frankenstein/releases/latest

ru.title: Новое приложение!
ru.message:
Новое приложение на замену старого 3WiFi Локатора.

Содержит множество нововведений: Wi-Fi карты, WPA-генераторы, Neighbor-based WPS PIN-генератор (как на сайте 3WiFi), PixieDust, возможность определения местоположения Wi-Fi по MAC-адресу и многое другое.

Скачать можно на GitHub:
https://github.com/LowSkillDeveloper/WIFI-Frankenstein/releases/latest
